Frequently Asked Questions
What is video interviewing software?
Video interviewing software is a digital tool for on-demand and live interviews. Candidates answer preset questions or join live calls from any device, and hiring teams can watch, rate, and share recordings in one place.
How does video interviewing software improve the hiring process?
The software handles scheduling, records responses, and collects feedback. Recruiters spend less time on phone screens and can move qualified candidates through the hiring steps more quickly.
What is the difference between on-demand and live video interviews?
In an on-demand video interview, candidates record answers to a list of questions on their own schedule. A live video interview happens in real time with the interviewer and candidate on the call together, similar to a video meeting.
How does Hirevue’s video interview platform support structured interviewing?
Hirevue includes interview guides, standard rating scales, and shared scorecards. This structure keeps interviews aligned to the same job criteria and makes it easier to compare candidates fairly.
Is Hirevue’s online video interview platform fair for candidates?
Hirevue uses consistent, structured questions, clear scoring rules, and regular reviews from organisational psychologists. The aim is to reduce bias, give all candidates a consistent experience, and help employers make defensible hiring decisions based on skills and data.
